label: Diagram 1
caption: Diagram 1 Size and proportion of residential buildings of not more than three storeys
description: The drawing is a technical diagram titled "Diagram 1 Size and proportion of residential buildings of not more than three storeys", with "See para 2C4" in the top left. It contains four line drawings. The top left shows a gable-fronted elevation standing on a sloping line labelled "Lowest ground level"; a vertical dimension on its right reads "H not to exceed 15m". The top middle shows a similar gable-fronted elevation with a vertical dimension "H" on the right, a horizontal dimension "W₁" below, and the words "Minimum width" above. The top right shows an elevation with a single sloping roof, a vertical dimension "H" on the left, a horizontal dimension "W₁" below, and the note "W₁ to be not less than 0.5 H" below. The lower drawing is a three-dimensional block of a house with a projecting single-storey extension; it is dimensioned "W₁" at the left, "P" along the front, "W₂" at the right, and "H₂" as the extension height, with the note "If P is more than 2W₂ then W₂ to be not less than 0.5 H₂".
